input.business_intent: Which is the best selling product?

args.sql_query:
-- Query 1: Best selling product by quantity and revenue
SELECT 
    product_name,
    category,
    SUM(total_quantity_sold) as total_quantity,
    SUM(total_sales_amount) as total_revenue,
    COUNT(DISTINCT transaction_date) as num_transactions,
    ROUND(AVG(total_sales_amount), 2) as avg_transaction_value,
    COUNT(DISTINCT store_name) as num_stores
FROM best_selling_product
GROUP BY product_name, category
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC
LIMIT 20

-- Query 2: Top 10 products by revenue
SELECT 
    product_name,
    category,
    SUM(total_quantity_sold) as total_quantity,
    SUM(total_sales_amount) as total_revenue,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(total_sales_amount) DESC) as revenue_rank
FROM best_selling_product
GROUP BY product_name, category
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 10

-- Query 3: Sales by category
SELECT 
    category,
    SUM(total_quantity_sold) as total_quantity,
    SUM(total_sales_amount) as total_revenue,
    COUNT(DISTINCT product_name) as num_products,
    ROUND(AVG(total_sales_amount), 2) as avg_transaction_value
FROM best_selling_product
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC

-- Query 4: Top 10 products with clean aggregation by quantity and revenue
SELECT 
    product_name,
    UPPER(TRIM(category)) as category_clean,
    SUM(total_quantity_sold) as total_quantity,
    SUM(total_sales_amount) as total_revenue,
    COUNT(*) as num_transactions,
    ROUND(SUM(total_sales_amount) / SUM(total_quantity_sold), 2) as avg_price_per_unit,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(total_quantity_sold) DESC) as quantity_rank,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(total_sales_amount) DESC) as revenue_rank
FROM best_selling_product
GROUP BY product_name, UPPER(TRIM(category))
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC
LIMIT 10
